title: Characterizing forbidden induced subgraphs that force top vertices to be Gallai vertices
summary: A vertex of a graph is called a top vertex if it has maximum degree in the graph. A vertex of a graph is called a Gallai vertex if it belongs to every longest path of the graph. Golan and Shan proved that every top vertex of any connected induced-$2P_2$ free graph is a Gallai vertex. Long, Milans, and Munaro subsequently showed that if every connected induced-$H$ free graph has a Gallai vertex, then $H$ must be a linear forest of order at most nine.
